title: Native dataset preflight v1; structural schema is not scientific or use authorization

dataset_kind.description: Declaration is not proof. Empirical scoring remains blocked even when structural checks pass.

aliases.description: Complete steward-attested alias to canonical group graph; cycles, duplicate canonical membership and cross-split overlap refused. Completeness cannot be proven by this file.

history_complete_through_h.description: Per-canonical-participant complete-history boundary; assertion requires independent review.

force_n_per_kg.description: Time-mean gross vertical force over the concentric interval divided by explicit system mass, N/kg.

impulse_m_per_s.description: Concentric integral of (Fz - m*g)dt / m, m/s.

depth_m.description: Nonnegative source reference-COM minus bottom-COM displacement in metres; independently authenticate COM reference and measurement provenance; do not infer depth from force alone.

time_h.description: Assessment time in hours on the dataset clock; exact origin offsets are derived.

available_at_h.description: When the assessment values were actually available, on the same clock.

system_mass_kg.description: Explicit accelerated system mass, including any external carried load; no body-mass substitution.

mechanics.description: Records source implementation conventions, not proof of empirical phase-detection/calibration authority.

known_at_h.description: Evidence-backed time the event duration or prescription was known; must be <= origin.

dataset_sha256.description: SHA256 of canonical complete dataset payload excluding reviews: JSON sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False. Bind every identity, numeric value, source, trial and preprocessing field.

prefixItems.description: Copy the finite baseline relative mean concentric force in N/kg. Baseline is measured before the prediction origin. Required finite numeric value; no imputation.

prefixItems.title: baseline.relative_concentric_net_impulse
prefixItems.description: Copy the finite baseline relative concentric net impulse in m/s. Baseline is measured before the prediction origin. Required finite numeric value; no imputation.

prefixItems.title: horizon.H72
prefixItems.description: One-hot indicator: 1.0 when horizon is H72, else 0.0. Forecast horizon is fixed at the prediction origin. Required registered enum; exactly one horizon indicator is 1.0.

prefixItems.title: horizon.D7
prefixItems.description: One-hot indicator: 1.0 when horizon is D7, else 0.0. Forecast horizon is fixed at the prediction origin. Required registered enum; exactly one horizon indicator is 1.0.

baseline_assessment_ids.description: Two latest qualifying valid assessment IDs in chronological order; offsets inclusive -240 through -24 hours.

history_assessment_ids.description: Exactly four chronological strictly pre-origin, actually available assessment summaries.

plans.description: Origin-frozen query-specific plans, including the index event at time zero. Third raw slot padding only follows original two-plan contract. H72 and D7 queries for one origin must agree on their shared plan prefix and historical/index exposures.

history_tokens.description: Columns h,N/kg,m/s,m; exactly equals raw feature columns 7–22 reshaped 4x4.

basis.description: Unscaled original-source W2 fast/slow duration-weighted, W3 total/fast/slow increment-weighted values; reconstructed and compared to same row.

timestamps_s.description: Strictly increasing seconds on signal clock; onset/takeoff must lie inside support.

force_n.description: Calibrated total vertical ground reaction force in N, matching timestamp count.

movement_start_s.description: Source-supplied movement start in seconds; first signal timestamp <= movement_start < concentric onset.

assessment_end_s.description: Source-supplied assessment end in seconds; takeoff <= assessment_end <= last signal timestamp.

x-authority-boundary: Scoped review records bind the entire dataset manifest (excluding reviews) and must match independently supplied trusted review pins. Pins establish byte identity, not provenance, consent or permission. All empirical execution is blocked. Metadata-only mode checks only identity/version/kind/candidate/source headers.

x-candidate-coverage.M0-M5: 39 raw fields, four chronological history tokens and horizon identity validated for complete common input coverage.
x-candidate-coverage.M6-M8: Additionally all five original-source basis components, source authority and row pairing.

x-expected-refusals: duplicate records or near-copy query vectors
x-steward-output-scope: All counts refer only to canonical declared test groups and their queries. Training and validation records remain necessary for separation checks but are excluded from every released count. Suppress entire vector for any small nonzero count/complement; disclose only with steward review.
